lines.zh: 灵魂飘过，留下蓝色光芒。
lines.en: Spirit drifts, leaving blue glow in its wake.

lines.zh: 它的声音如风铃般清脆。
lines.en: Its voice chimes like a gentle breeze.

lines.zh: 它偶尔发出微弱的咒语声。
lines.en: It mutters faintly from time to time.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临时，它变得愈发活跃。
lines.en: It grows more active as night falls.
It glides through the sky slowly.

lines.zh: 发出闪烁的光芒，照亮道路。
lines.en: It emits flickering light, illuminating the path.
Its eyes shine with wisdom.
It occasionally hums a low chant.

lines.zh: 飞行中留下淡淡的蓝烟。
lines.en: It leaves a faint blue trail as it flies.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀发出轻微的摩擦声。
lines.en: Its wings make a soft friction sound.

lines.zh: 静静站立，仿佛来自另一个世界。
lines.en: It stands quietly, seeming from another world.

lines.zh: 偶尔凝视深渊，若有所思。
lines.en: It occasionally gazes into the abyss, deep in thought.

lines.zh: 它凝视着远方，目光深邃。
lines.en: It stares into the distance, its gaze deep.

lines.zh: 它的存在令空气都感到寒冷。
lines.en: Its presence makes the air feel cold.

lines.zh: 有时会轻柔地哼唱起歌。
lines.en: It sometimes hums a gentle tune.
It stands quietly, like a statue.

lines.zh: 偶尔轻摆翅膀，似乎在舞蹈。
lines.en: It occasionally flutters its wings, as if dancing.

lines.zh: 它低头凝视着自己的影子。
lines.en: It lowers its head to gaze at its shadow.

lines.zh: 静静地观察着四周的动静。
lines.en: It quietly observes its surroundings.
It occasionally strokes its feathers gently.
I have waited long in this dungeon.

lines.zh: 灵魂水晶的光映在我身上。
lines.en: Soul crystal light falls on me.
My shadow does not quite follow me.
I remember every challenger.

lines.zh: 我们实力相当，这才有趣。
lines.en: We are equals; that is the fun.

lines.zh: 地牢的风把我的声音吹散。
lines.en: The dungeon wind scatters my voice.

lines.zh: 它盯着玩家，眼神中透着好奇。
lines.en: It stares at the player, its eyes full of curiosity.

lines.zh: 当玩家靠近时，它保持警惕。
lines.en: It remains vigilant when the player approaches.
It suddenly takes an interest in the player.
My spirit weighs your courage.

lines.zh: 玩家的存在让它显得更加专注。
lines.en: Its presence makes it more focused.

lines.zh: 它似乎认出了玩家，显得更温和。
lines.en: It seems to recognize the player, becoming more gentle.

lines.zh: 它仔细观察着玩家的每一个动作。
lines.en: It closely observes every movement of the player.

lines.zh: 玩家一动它就注意到了。
lines.en: It notices the player the moment they move.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中闪过一丝恐惧。
lines.en: A hint of fear flashes in its eyes.

lines.zh: 它似乎认出了玩家，变得友好。
lines.en: It recognizes the player and becomes friendly.

lines.zh: 它在你身上看到了自己。
lines.en: It sees itself in you.

lines.zh: 它用蓝光量了量你的胆量。
lines.en: Its blue glow measures your nerve.

lines.zh: 灵魂在游荡中突然消失！
lines.en: The Spirit fades suddenly!
The Spirit's aura fades...
The Spirit is becoming unstable...
The Spirit's light dims...
The Spirit's form warps...
The Spirit wavers...
The Spirit's light fades...
The Spirit seems to waver...
The Spirit's form blurs...
The Spirit seems to drift...
You seem to draw me in.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我看看你的力量。
lines.en: Come on, let me see your strength.
Why not join me?

lines.zh: 你的存在很独特，就像我一样。
lines.en: Your presence is unique, like me.
You don't seem threatening.
Let's team up and create greatness together.

lines.zh: 你为何不品尝我的力量？
lines.en: Why not taste my power?
Your courage attracts me.

lines.zh: 你的力量足以成为我的伙伴。
lines.en: Your strength is enough to be my ally.
You seem to be my kind.

lines.zh: 我也有身体，撞得一样疼。
lines.en: I have a body too; it hurts just the same.

lines.zh: 你的力量碰上了我的力量。
lines.en: Your strength met mine.
We had a head-on clash.
We ended up destroying each other.

lines.zh: 我们的力量互相抵消了。
lines.en: Our powers neutralized.
You and I sparked a connection.

lines.zh: 我们之间的力量相互作用。
lines.en: Our powers interacted.

lines.zh: 我们的力量在对抗中融合了。
lines.en: Our powers merged in the struggle.
Our powers clashed.
Our powers collided.
Let's become partners.
We should be together.
Come be my partner.
In the dungeon, waiting for you to summon me.

lines.zh: 地牢里只剩我们两个，正好。
lines.en: Only the two of us remain in this dungeon. Good.
We fit together well.
Let's spend a lifetime together.
You are my true partner.

lines.zh: 和我在一起，你会幸福的。
lines.en: You'll be happy with me.
We are meant to be together.
Glimmering light, the spirit awakens!

lines.zh: 飘过你身旁，我就是灵魂！
lines.en: Passing by, I am the spirit.

lines.zh: 饥饿的光芒引导我而来！
lines.en: The glow of hunger guides me here.
Your heartbeat, my call.

lines.zh: 我捡起那把钥匙，光跟着亮。
lines.en: I pick up the key, and the light follows.
The spirit's flame, burning on.

lines.zh: 跟随我的指引，找到归宿！
lines.en: Follow my guidance, find your home.
My power equals yours.
The spirit's door, opening soon.
Here, your eternal home awaits.
Acquiring target, starting track.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，灵魂已发现你！
lines.en: You cannot escape, the spirit has found you.
The spirit's gaze, cannot be avoided.
Feel my gaze?
The spirit has sensed you.
Locked on by the spirit!

lines.zh: 灵魂将引导你走向终结！
lines.en: The spirit will guide you to your end.
The spirit's power is everywhere.
The spirit has locked onto your soul.
My gaze, cannot be ignored.
You have entered my dungeon.
You hold the key, don't you?

lines.zh: 灵魂之间，也得分个高低。
lines.en: Even spirits must settle rank.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂我见过，在别处。
lines.en: I've seen your soul before, elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这场比试，我早就等着了。
lines.en: I have waited for this duel.
You draw first; then we begin.

lines.zh: 同等的力量，同等的结局。
lines.en: Equal power, equal ending.

lines.zh: 这里是我的领域，我的规则。
lines.en: Here my domain, my rules.
Releasing spirit power!
The spirit's breath becomes a blade.
The spirit will judge you.
The spirit's light is coming.
The spirit's judgment cannot be resisted.
The spirit's fire will burn all.
The spirit's sword is drawn.
The spirit's light will illuminate you.

lines.zh: 灵魂之力，将决定你的命运！
lines.en: The spirit's power will decide your fate.
The spirit's sword will fall.
Blue fire circles around me.
My hilt is already warm.

lines.zh: 你出招，我就知道下一步。
lines.en: Strike, and I know your next step.
A spirit needs no breath.
I can see your hesitation.
I count what blood you have left.
The harder you swing, the clearer I see.
Light comes first; the blade follows.
Only one step stands between us.
Do not blink; spirits are swift.
Rumble and the spirit显现！
Fighting till the end, with death as a companion.
The spirit possesses, fearless and fierce.
Wrath formed, a roar to slay.
Spirit wrath, endless strikes.
Inflamed, spirit assault.
Transform into a ghost, a single strike to kill.
In the dark, the spirit roars.
Soul devours, death descends.
Soul binds, the battle ends.
My blade slips through your armor.
A flash of blue, and I have struck.
This blow returns to you.
Pain is real even for spirits.
Spirit awakens, in the dungeon.
Grim spirit awakens, in the dark.
Spirit descends, battle starts.
Deep spirit awakens in the dark.
Spirit's shadow descends into the dungeon.
Wrath condensed, the spirit appears.
Spirit's light, in the darkness.
Wraith appears, battle erupts.
Spirit's eye, seeing all.
Spirit calls, battle begins.
The spirit dungeon lights up.
A challenger spoke the rite.
I step out of the crystal.

lines.zh: 能与我一战的人不多了。
lines.en: Few can still match me now.
I keep no treasure, only rules.
Who are you, and what do you bring?

lines.zh: 据说这里困过一个灵魂。
lines.en: They say a spirit was trapped here.
Did you hear the chime?

lines.zh: 我们平等，也平等地危险。
lines.en: Equal, and equally dangerous.

lines.zh: 地牢第九层，我第一次睁眼。
lines.en: On the ninth floor I first opened my eyes.
Fire burns the Spirit...
The Spirit falls from a great height...
The Spirit is drowned...
The Spirit is torn by the explosion...
The Spirit is hit by an arrow...
The Spirit is sealed by magic...
The Spirit grows weak from hunger...
Lightning strikes the Spirit...
The Spirit falls into the void...
